$comment: Count-based render budgets (ARCHITECTURE.md §4), enforced in CI by tests/perf/budgets.perf.spec.ts. SwiftShader fps means nothing, so only counts are checked: draw calls (shadow-pass draws included), triangles and the estimated resident texture memory. Change a number only with a reason in the PR. firstLoadJsGzipKb is checked after the build by tools/bundle-budget.ts (Rapier chunk excluded).
